Row 2: $\begin{aligned}A&=6\times3\\A&=18\text{ m}^2\\A&=18\times100^2\text{ cm}^2\\A&=180\,000\text{ cm}^2\\A&=180\,000\times10^2\text{ mm}^2\\A&=18\,000\,000\text{ mm}^2\end{aligned}$

answer.short: Row 4: Missing side: $4\text{ m}$; $20\text{ m}^2$; $20\,000\,000\text{ mm}^2$.
answer.worked: Row 4: $\begin{aligned}A&=200\,000\div100^2\text{ m}^2\\A&=20\text{ m}^2\\\text{Missing side}&=20\div5\\\text{Missing side}&=4\text{ m}\\A&=200\,000\times10^2\text{ mm}^2\\A&=20\,000\,000\text{ mm}^2\end{aligned}$

answer.short: Row 5: Missing side: $7\text{ m}$; $21\text{ m}^2$; $210\,000\text{ cm}^2$.
answer.worked: Row 5: $\begin{aligned}A&=21\,000\,000\div10^2\text{ cm}^2\\A&=210\,000\text{ cm}^2\\A&=210\,000\div100^2\text{ m}^2\\A&=21\text{ m}^2\\\text{Missing side}&=21\div3\\\text{Missing side}&=7\text{ m}\end{aligned}$

Row 6: $\begin{aligned}\text{Missing side}&=2.2\div11\\\text{Missing side}&=0.2\text{ m}\\A&=2.2\times100^2\text{ cm}^2\\A&=22\,000\text{ cm}^2\\A&=22\,000\times10^2\text{ mm}^2\\A&=2\,200\,000\text{ mm}^2\end{aligned}$
